name: kesher
description: Production website for Shira Saharoni, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-post-summaries.cjs && node scripts/generate-sitemap.cjs && node scripts/generate-llms-full.cjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prerender.cjs
scripts.lint: eslint src functions tests scripts/*.cjs scripts/generate-article-image.js vite.config.js
scripts.test:video-policy: python3 -m unittest tests.kesher_daily_pipeline_suite tests.test_video_review_policy tests.test_video_review_schema tests.test_video_reconcile tests.test_video_upload_guard -v
scripts.test:controller: python3 -m unittest tests.test_kesher_content_controller tests.test_kesher_controller_queue tests.test_controller_artifact_download tests.test_jules_article_runner tests.test_jules_article_diagnostics tests.test_single_scheduler_policy tests.test_production_contract_v3 tests.test_article_image_worker tests.test_pipeline_v3_self_audit -v
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run lint && npm run test:content && npm run test:video-policy && npm run test:controller && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:dist && npm run test:e2e

author: Shira Saharoni
